_meta.name: taskmaster-chaos-fixtures
_meta.purpose: Deterministic edge-case data for QA and chaos testing. Everything here targets a documented behaviour of the API: trimming, JSON tag encoding, sort order, SQL-injection/XSS probes, unicode handling, and status codes.
_meta.howToRun: Start an instance (npx wrangler dev), then: npm run seed -- --api http://localhost:8787
_meta.deterministic: No wall-clock dependence in the payloads. Dates are fixed strings; only created_at is server-assigned at insert time.
_meta.caveat: The API assigns created_at = Date.now() per request, so todos seeded later have a LATER created_at. Because the sort is created_at DESC, a later-seeded todo sorts BEFORE an earlier one when every other key ties.

todos.title: Overdue task from the past
todos.description: due_date is far in the past. Must appear in status=active and sort early among unpinned items.

todos.title: Due today
todos.description: due_date equals 2026-10-16, the fixture authoring date. GET /api/stats only counts dueToday when the server clock is the same date.

todos.title: Due in the year 2099
todos.description: Extreme future date sorts last among unpinned items.

todos.title: No due date at all
todos.description: due_date is NULL. In SQLite, NULL sorts FIRST under ASC, so this appears BEFORE dated todos among unpinned items — that is the current behaviour to verify, not a bug to fix silently.

todos.description: Same title as duplicate-b. Ties break on created_at DESC.

todos.title: Identical title for sort testing

todos.title: Unpinned with the same due date
todos.description: Same due_date as the pinned pair but unpinned, so it must sort after both.

todos.description: POST trims title and description. The stored row must not keep the surrounding spaces.

todos.title: Lives in the deletable list

negativeCases.reason: A whitespace-only title must be rejected with 400, not stored as an empty row.
A todo with no title field must be rejected with 400.

expectations.sortOrder: is_pinned DESC, due_date ASC, created_at DESC
expectations.nullDatesSortFirst: SQLite sorts NULL ascending before real dates, so null-due-date appears before dated items among unpinned todos.
expectations.trimming: whitespace-trimmed must be stored without surrounding spaces.
expectations.injectionSurvives: After seeding, GET /api/todos must return all rows and the sql-probe todo must still exist — proving the DROP was treated as data.
expectations.listDeletionReassigns: Deleting list-deletable must move deletable-list-member to list_id 'inbox'.
expectations.pinnedBeatsDates: pinned-tie-1 and pinned-tie-2 must sort ahead of every unpinned todo regardless of due_date.
